title: Security Camera Placement: Where to Put Them
description: The optimal placement for security cameras around your home. Maximum coverage with minimum cameras.
keywords: security camera placement, where to put security cameras, camera positioning, home security setup
content:
Where you place cameras matters more than how many you have. Here's the optimal setup.

Front Door

Place at eye level (5-6 feet). Cover the entire doorway and porch. This captures 34% of all burglaries.

Back Door

Same setup as front door. 22% of burglars enter through the back door.

Living Room

Corner placement gives 110-degree coverage. Aim at the main entry points.

Garage

Mount high (8-10 feet) pointing down. Covers vehicles and equipment.

Yard

Weather-resistant cameras only. Cover driveway and main approach paths.

Common Mistakes

Don't place too high (can't see faces). Don't point at the sun (washout). Don't forget about lighting (night vision needs some light).
